lower weight loss effectiveness during dietary treatments for obesity. Some of these associations are functionally explained by the
presence of a polymorphism involving a change in the structure of the mRNA leading to a change in gene expression (Garaulet and
Madrid, 2010).

PER2 (rs2304672C > G and rs4663302C > T) have been associated with abdominal obesity and obesogenic behaviors. In partic-
